ingameEffects.description: When EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

ingameEffects.label: Clocking Out Myth (Mindscape Cinema N°2)
ingameEffects.description: EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill deals 5% more Daze. For each Eye of the Storm detonated, gain 1 stack of Windflow}, up to 3 stacks. During EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill, if Roxy switches out after entering the Whirlwind state, she consumes all Windflow. Each stack consumed sustains the Whirlwind state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s. When EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This Mindscape Cinema does not affect Roxy's stats.

ingameEffects.label: R.I.P. (Mindscape Cinema N°4)
ingameEffects.description: When a Defensive Assist successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill. When Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill. Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Roxy's DMG from Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial is increased by 20%.

ingameEffects.label: Eternity and the Clockwork Doll (Mindscape Cinema N°6)
ingameEffects.description: The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES. When Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off detonates Eyes of the Storm to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with Afterecho. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of Afterecho. The DMG dealt by the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Roxy's DMG ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES.

damageBonuses.hitName: Giant Windstorm DMG Multiplier per Second

basicAttacks.name: Do Stay a While (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] to activate:

Performs up to 4 strikes forward, dealing Wind DMG.

dashAttacks.name: Forgive My Rudeness (Dash Attack)
dashAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] during a dodge to activate:

Strikes forward, dealing Wind DMG.

dodgeCounters.name: Returned Courtesy (Dodge Counter)
dodgeCounters.description:
Press [BASIC] during a [COUNTER] to activate:

Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: At Your Service (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
When the on-field character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

perfectAssists.name: More Overtime? (Assist)
perfectAssists.description:
After activating a /bDefensive Assist//b, press [ASSIST] again to activate:

Roxy stays on the field and strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG. This skill is treated as activating a /bBasic Attack//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Midnight Code (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
Press [BASIC] after a /bDefensive Assist//b to activate:

Strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Much Obliged (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
Press [SPECIAL] to activate:

Performs a forward strike, dealing Wind DMG.

specialAttacks.name: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
After activating /bEX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace//b, this attack is automatically activated when the total number of /bEyes of the Storm//b on the field and Roxy's /bWind Energy//b reaches at least 3:

Throws her hammer at enemies on the field, dealing Wind DMG. /bEyes of the Storm//b hit by this attack are detonated, up to 3 /bEyes of the Storm//b at a time. Based on the number detonated, a corresponding number of /b/bMiniature Windstorm//bs//b are generated, dealing Wind DMG.

If 3 /bEyes of the Storm//b are detonated at once, a /bGiant Windstorm//b is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Eye of the Storm (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
Generated after /bEX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace//b consumes /bWind Energy//b, and automatically detonates after 30s.

Up to 9 /bEyes of the Storm//b can exist at the same time. If this limit is exceeded, the earliest generated /bEye of the Storm//b will automatically detonate.

Detonates when hit by /bSpecial Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off//b. If fewer than 3 are hit at the same time, 1 /bMiniature Windstorm//b is generated at the location of each Eye of the Storm, tracking enemies and dealing Wind DMG for 1s.

If 3 are hit at the same time, 1 /bGiant Windstorm//b is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG for 1s. When detonated by any means, an /bEye of the Storm//b releases a blast, dealing 1 instance of Wind DMG to nearby enemies.

hits.name: Miniature Windstorm DMG Multiplier per Second
Giant Windstorm DMG Multiplier per Second

exSkills.name: Don't Catch a Chill (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX] to activate:

Slides forward, dealing Wind DMG.

While sliding, press and hold [EX] to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state:

While in the /bWhirlwind//b state, Roxy generates a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Wind DMG to enemies along its path.

When Energy is depleted, or when [EX] is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the /bWhirlwind//b state. When the slide ends or when exiting the /bWhirlwind//b state, automatically follows up with /bEX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

exSkills.name: Kindly Rest in Peace (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
Automatically activates after /bEX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill//b ends:

Consumes all /bWind Energy//b to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Wind DMG. After the attack, for each point of /bWind Energy//b consumed, deals an additional instance of Wind DMG and generates 1 /bEye of the Storm//b at the current position. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chainAttacks.name: Gale-Burial Great Hammer (Chain Attack)
chainAttacks.description:
When a /bChain Attack//b is triggered, select the character to activate:

Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front, dealing massive Wind DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: Requiem for the Night-Burial (Ultimate)
ultimate.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [ULTIMATE] to activate:

Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Wind DMG. After the skill ends, gains 1 /bWind Energy//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
